body:
Follow-up to `robofab-graspfast` (track 4). Maps which MuJoCo `solref`/timestep settings reproduce the friction-grasp jaw-force bound at 100–800 m/s² on all seven toy-gripper parts, plus a `solref` × acceleration boundary scan. Stylised, upward load only, simulation only.

- 63 cases at `solref` ≤ 0.2 ms: ratio 0.98–1.04 of the bound.
- 0.5 ms / 0.2 ms: matches at 100 m/s², fails (no force ≤ 60 N holds) at 400 and 800 on all 7 parts.
- Boundary is not a single threshold on `a·solref`.

Checks: 5 unit tests pass, `python site/build.py` prints ok, README numbers re-checked against `results.json`.
